text: Survival order that has worked: wood, then tools, then food (hunt, cook with smelt), shelter before night, a bed, then iron, armor and a base.
Before night, sleep in a bed if you have one; otherwise use the shelter goal. Mobs spawn from timeOfDay 13000.
Caves and mines are far more dangerous at night. Around timeOfDay 11500 stop deep mining and get to the surface or wall in before dark.
Keep at least 8 food in your inventory. Hunt while animals are around, cook the meat, and start a wheat field (start_wheat_field skill) once you have seeds.
After your health drops low, let it recover to about 14 before mining or fighting again.
Craft a shield (1 iron ingot + 6 planks) as soon as you have an iron ingot. The fight reflex walks at skeletons behind it; without one, running from archers gets you shot in the back.
Flooded caves and deep water drowned you before. Collect with avoidWater: true underground, and don't swim back for dropped items.
Below y=20 mobs are thicker. Until you have 2+ armor pieces and 4+ food, collect with minY: 20; iron is common above that too.
